historical_feasibility_context.interpretation: This aggregate observation justifies attempting the already frozen science under a fail-stop envelope. It is not a per-fit maximum, guarantee, projection gate, acceptance statistic, optimization target, or authority to alter the battery.

cumulative_resource_envelope.measurement_scope: Begin before any future claim consumption or official source open and end only after terminal publication attempt and cleanup. Include trusted compiler, model children, scorer, bootstrap, diagnostics, publisher, logs, temporary files, cleanup, and all descendants.
cumulative_resource_envelope.relationship_to_d_122: Each nonzero limit is exactly 80 percent of the D-122 ceiling and preserves its previously frozen additional margin.

supervisor.clock: Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC measured outside the restricted work root
supervisor.cpu: Cumulative user plus system CPU for the supervisor and every descendant, including terminated children; no child may detach or escape accounting.
supervisor.storage: Maximum allocated bytes across the complete fixed restricted root, including hidden and temporary files; paths outside that root are forbidden except authenticated read-only inputs and runtime libraries.
supervisor.rss: Maximum simultaneous resident set size of supervisor plus all live descendants, not the maximum of one process in isolation.
supervisor.gpu: No GPU device, runtime, environment visibility, allocation, or use is permitted.
supervisor.child_signal_policy: On any limit or invariant miss, terminate the active process group, escalate once if required, retain no model state, publish no partial scientific terminal, and clean the complete restricted root before aggregate rejection.
supervisor.warning_policy: Any Python warning, CatBoost warning, fallback, nonzero exit, nonfinite value, signal, timeout, or incomplete accounting rejects the attempt.

cumulative_resource_envelope.acceptance_rule: All scientific identities complete and every hard limit passes conjunctively. Equality passes non-GPU maxima; GPU use must equal zero. No mean, projection, extrapolation, partial completion, or favorable stage can substitute.
cumulative_resource_envelope.budget_rule: Unused capacity cannot fund a retry, resume, moved root, repair, alternate order, smaller battery, extra candidate, seed, threshold, feature, metric, clip, model, optimization, cache, or concurrency change.

least_privilege_stage_graph.scorer_and_selector: Open only matching validation truth and immutable baseline rows after the complete stage freeze; apply D-122 arithmetic and selection once; never emit a runner-up or row-level artifact.
least_privilege_stage_graph.diagnostics: Run D-122 duplicate, influence, source, endpoint, and training-only clipping diagnostics after required freezes without adding a fit or revising the selected token.
